children: waits with bated breath for any update from Shiba Inu lead developer Shytoshi Kusama, who continues to stay under the radar on X. Development activity has been going on across the Shiba Inu ecosystem, but at a low level.

Kusama's last post or interaction on X was May 13, 2026. His long absence has not gone unnoticed by members of the community, especially after some slight updates to his profile sparked speculation about what he might be doing.

Kusama updated his X bio to simply "Polish" and his location to "Close" in September 2026. The changes prompted speculation that a project could be approaching completion. However, Kusama has not confirmed whether the updates relate to Shiba Inu, his independent artificial intelligence initiative or another undertaking, amid his ongoing silence on social media.
Shiba Inu sees quiet ecosystem updates
has continued despite Kusama's silence on social media. Community members and developers have shared information about Shibarium infrastructure and the Shiba Inu ecosystem in recent times.

In September 2026, longtime community member Mazrael shared Shiba Inu developer Kaal Dhairya's message to the community that the Shibarium reorg is now solved, with the remaining step being for the DRPC to complete the same transition in the new environment.
Mazrael, in a recent discussion on X, noted that Shiba Inu's Shibarium is still in rebuild mode. Despite this, the Shiba Inu layer-2 has received quiet improvements and features in recent weeks.

CreateX, the standard factory developers use to deploy contracts at the same address on every chain, went live on Shibarium, according to Mazrael, while all 12 Safe v1.4.1 contracts have been deployed at their canonical addresses via the Safe Singleton Factory. x402 is fully live on Shibarium, allowing AI agents to pay in SHIB, TREAT or wrapped BONE.

The Shibarium RPC listing was refreshed in the Ethereum-lists/chains registry, with updated connection details now available on Chainlist. In September 2026, the official SHIB website and the ShibaSwap page moved to Cloudflare, with IPv6 added on both, leaving the old host behind.

title: Shiba Inu: Shytoshi Kusama's X Silence Lingers Amid Quiet Developments
